turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. I have until 4:40, and Owen found out about that zero on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided it, and why did nobody call me first?
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
Aside. The grade is the only reason I'm in this room, Hale, so who decided it?
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
You're asking me how to do your job? Take the zero off and pick up the phone next time. Now answer me: who decided it?
